answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network isolates each unverified node onto an untrusted island until it deposits a verifiable cryptographic stake. To emit a consensus signal, an agent executes stake burning where registration fees scale with superlinear cost, O(N^1.5), relative to identity volume. Even a distributed raven swarm coordinated by an attacker faces exponential resource drain, making multi-identity simulation economically prohibitive.
